    Long lines from large indecomposables #

    Without contours, a large indecomposable over a convex piece lives on a convex subtree (exists_sincere_piece), and a long path of this tree contains a line of the cover (exists_cline).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.rtg_of_reach {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hpar : ParEq S) (hacyc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) (l : List (pieceQuiver S).A), l ≠ [] → ¬FinQuiver.PathFrom i l i) (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) {a c : Cover x₀} (ha : a ∈ S) (hc : c ∈ S) (h : a.Reach c) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (pieceDirData hacyc).Arr ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
